notes: The text layer holds only a repeated watermark (NII-Electronic Library Service), so the paper was read from the six page images. The paper is original experimental work on H2S (not H2) adsorption on activated carbons Nos. 2-6 and a zeolite, by a spring-balance gravimetric method at 20, 30 and 40 C up to 500 Torr, with Dubinin-Astakhov analysis, isosteric heats and pore size distributions from N2 at -195.8 C. H2S is an excluded gas under I1. The paper is not computation-only and not electrochemical, so the I1 failure takes no_conditions_stated. Not a review, not retracted (is_retracted false, no retraction notice on any page), and no statement that its values were published before. No H2 uptake value appears anywhere in the paper.
